author: lactify
body:
Hello Staff Team of Avicus. As the appeal suggests, I was temp-banned for encouraging suicide. This is my appeal to see if I can be unbanned, if not at the most, have my ban shortened.

Let me start off by saying that with all honesty, I would never do this. I would never ever tell a person to 'kys'. Stupidly, I let my anger get the better of me, and I've now seen that it's come with a consequence. I understand that during my ban duration, I should think about what my actions have on other people. I let one game turn me into someone I would never be. I am so sorry deep down to doing this. This isn't me, the community, staff and my server friends know that this is not like me. I apologise sincerely to anyone I may have offended/hurt. I am hoping that I can get back on good terms with anyone I hurt/ and fix the wrong I've done. I promise to learn from the stupid action I did earlier today. I am so so sorry. I hope that even if I don't get unbanned, I can at least be forgiven. Thank you.

title: MarcuzFireZ's appeal for SE.

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Hey, Marcuz.
I am glad you have learned your mistake, but however, suicide is a serious and sensitive topic around the world; something we don't want players encouraging to others around the server.

Your ban still remains.
